events.evidence: The People's Bank of China announces a 2 percent revaluation of its currency, the Renminbi (yuan), and says the yuan will no longer be pegged to the US dollar

Parts of the London Underground are evacuated, as British police are investigating reports of three separate incidents involving minor explosions in Shepherd's Bush, Warren Street and Oval underground
Malaysian government also remove the ringgit's peg to US dollar.

label.note: China's yuan revaluation and London bomb scares create mixed risk appetite signals.
